question: apple 2026 was good or bad as compare to profits of 2025??

result.answer:
Apple Inc.'s net income rose from $112.01B (FY2025) to $132.18B (FY2026), representing a change of +$20.16B (+18.00%) [F]. 

This suggests that Apple's profitability improved in 2026 compared to 2025 [F]. Additional details regarding financial performance include:

* **Products Gross Margin:** Was $139,659 million in 2026, $112,887 million in 2025, and $109,633 million in 2024 [1].
* **Services Gross Margin:** Was $93,943 million in 2026, $82,314 million in 2025, and $71,050 million in 2024 [1]. Services gross margin percentage increased during 2026 compared to 2025 due to a different mix of services, partially offset by higher costs [3].
* **Research and Development (R&D) Expense:** Was $45,765 million (32% change, 10% of total net sales) in 2026, $34,550 million (10% change, 8% of total net sales) in 2025, and $31,370 million (8% of total net sales) in 2024 [2][3]. R&D increased in 2026 due to higher infrastructure costs (including artificial intelligence investments) and headcount expenses [2].
* **Selling, General and Administrative (SG&A) Expense:** Was $29,774 million (8% change, 6% of total net sales) in 2026, $27,601 million (6% change, 7% of total net sales) in 2025, and $26,097 million (7% of total net sales) in 2024 [2][3].
